caption:
Swipe to see why the AI jobs apocalypse probably isn't coming — and why experts say that's not actually good news 👇

Researchers say AI may never deliver on its promise of vast economic opportunity, not because it lacks capability but because the cost — disruption, inequality, social upheaval — is more than society is willing to pay. The jobs apocalypse is probably off the table. But that doesn't mean nothing is changing: businesses already using AI to handle routine work are pulling ahead of those who aren't.

The AI jobs narrative is shifting from apocalypse to quiet competitive gap. The companies that act now gain leverage; the ones waiting for the dust to settle may find the race already run.
